games.name: Heavens Arena (TS Sasuke Update)
games.desc:
A fighting game featuring a large variety of anime characters.

Controls:
Shift - Mouse Lock
M1 - Basic Attack
M2 - Side Launcher
E + M2 - Up Launcher
1 - Move #1
2 - Move #2
3 - Move #3
4 - Ultimate Move
5 - Move #5 (E + 4)
E - Alternate
Q - Dash
F - Block
R - Assist
C - Evasion
E + C - Limit Burst
Left Control (In Air) - Fast Fall
G - Character Emote (Gamepass Required)
E + G - Character Alternate Emote (Gamepass Required)
